method.related_comment_policy: Read relevant author corrections, closure/fix notes, maintainer requests, and selected review summaries; not every comment of long threads was read in full.
limitations: Purposive sample; no ecosystem prevalence estimate.
Issue titles and older bodies can be superseded by later corrections.
Automatic review comments are not independent runtime verification.
A merged PR does not prove a published release contains the fix.
Closed/not_planned and stale closure do not prove implementation.
Duplicate comments are not independent users.
Priorities and RstrBot acceptance criteria are product-design inferences, not upstream priorities.
